name: Skill Recorder
description: Record a desktop workflow and turn it into a generated Skill (record-and-replay). Captures clicks / typing / scrolls plus the on-screen elements, then an LLM drafts a reusable SKILL.md you review and save.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: Recording needs a native global input hook + screen capture (record_* Tauri commands) — desktop only.

tauri.reason: Drives the Rust recorder in src-tauri/src/automation/record/ via the record_* Tauri commands.
